meta.title: Auto power-off
meta.description: Shut down, hibernate, or lock this computer after every session and background job has finished. Open the Auto power-off entry at the bottom of the left sidebar to enable it and choose the action, idle wait, countdown, and optional active window; outside that window nothing is detected or timed, and only runs that start inside it count. Once a countdown starts, the sidebar foot shows the remaining time and the panel offers a cancel button. The plugin works only while DSH runs, and the dry run performs no system action.
